KF0.label: KF0: K5b re-run on the edited main copy (flags off)

KF1.label: KF1: sell all at 23, farmer holds the excess at 0 (always), sell the excess at 1

KF2.label: KF2: KF1 with the farmer holding only when the wheat buy needs room

KF4.label: KF4: farmer holds the excess at 0, sell it at 1 (no h23 sale)

KC1.label: KC1: farmer = melons or central unit (radius 2), holds the excess at 0 only when the wheat buy needs room, puts it back with PLACE at 2 (sold at once), the dump sold at hour 1 with sells before seed buys

KC2.label: KC2 = KC1 with the hour-1 sale fixed (counts the shed after the hour-1 pickups, so the hour-2 hires keep their wheat)

KC2j.label: KC2j = KC2 + wheat bought just in time (every hour, what the next hour's planned pickups lack)

KH7.label: KH7 = KC2j + spread hire (at most 7 at hour 0, the rest at hour 1) + the freed hour-0 slots sell the excess before the wheat buy; hour-1 wheat buy after the sales; no farmer hold

KH8.label: KH8 = KC2j + spread hire (at most 8 at hour 0, the rest at hour 1) + the freed hour-0 slots sell the excess before the wheat buy; hour-1 wheat buy after the sales; no farmer hold

KH9.label: KH9 = KC2j + spread hire (at most 9 at hour 0, the rest at hour 1) + the freed hour-0 slots sell the excess before the wheat buy; hour-1 wheat buy after the sales; no farmer hold

KH8b.label: KH8b = K5b + spread hire (8 at hour 0, the rest at hour 1) + the freed hour-0 slots sell the dump excess except wheat and milk (left to the leader-following market) + wheat bought just in time; no hour-1 dump sale, no central farmer
